sections.html: Semaprochilodus have been imported from Venezuela. There is a lot of confusion about the correct identification of Semaprochilodus species in aquarium literature and on the internet. S. laticeps, whose identification here is beyond doubt, is most often illustrated under the names S. taeniurus (a different species, from Brazil) or S. theraponura (currently regarded as a synonym of S. insignis, which originates from Peru).
